description: This file defines multiple onboarding guide fragments for a fitness app, managing user onboarding steps such as welcome, goal selection, duration preferences, analytics opt-in, and completion.

classes.name: WelcomeOnboardingFragment
classes.description: First screen welcoming the user and providing options to skip or proceed to the next step.

classes.name: GoalsOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Screens for selecting multiple fitness goals via checkboxes.

classes.name: DurationOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Allows user to select preferred workout duration via radio options.

methods.name: onCreateGuidance
methods.description: Creates guidance information (title, description) for each fragment.

methods.name: onCreateActions
methods.description: Defines user actions/buttons available on each onboarding fragment.

methods.name: onGuidedActionClicked
methods.description: Handles user interaction with actions, progressing the onboarding flow or saving preferences.

methods.name: actionToGoalId
methods.description: Maps a selected action back to its goal ID.
